ACADEMIC EXCHANGE FORM 
(for student)
With my signature, I hereby confirm that 
I do not suffer from any disease, which might endanger the health of others. 
I have not been declared as incapacitated and am not in provisional tutelage. 
False, erroneous, or incomplete statements can result in the enrolment being revoked. 
I undertake to give immediate notification of any change of address. 
I will follow the host institution’s instructions to obtain study visa for this mobility

Declaration
I herewith declare that the statements given by me in the Academic Exchange Form are correct and complete. 

_____________ __________________ ________________
City			Date			Signature 

Attachments
Required documents:
 Academic exchange form with signature, full name
 Nomination letter
 Curriculum Vitae
 Motivation letter
 Official Academic Transcript in English (issued by the applicant’s home institution)
 A proof of English language skills
 One copy of the passport
 One copy of the passport photo
